description.value: South Surrey Arena is a City of Surrey-operated recreation facility and one of only two Olympic-sized ice rinks in the Lower Mainland. It sits within the South Surrey Athletic Park, surrounded by forests and athletic fields, making it a distinctive destination in the South Surrey landscape. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it a notable stopover or destination for a skate session.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The City of Surrey website confirms the facility is open, provides the phone number (604-502-6200) not present in OSM, and corroborates the address. The website describes it as one of only two Olympic-sized rinks in the Lower Mainland, located within South Surrey Athletic Park. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all criteria remain null.
